messages: Holodeck 2 is unstable. Enter at your own risk.
Radiation leak in the port nacelle. Avoid area.
Transporter maintenance. Count your limbs on arrival.
Replicator 3 serves only decaf. Engineering notified.
Unidentified life-form in cargo bay. Possibly a potato.
Shields at 40%. Captain's optimism remains at 100%.
Gravity testing at 1400. Secure your lunch.
Tribble count exceeds available storage.
Red alert cancelled. Someone leaned on the console.
Please stop asking the computer for dating advice.
Warp core humming detected. It knows only one song.
Deck 7 gravity restored. Ceiling crew may stand down.
Holodeck dragons must remain inside the holodeck.
Captain's log missing. Check under the captain's chair.
Transporter room closed for a minor identity crisis.
Shuttle Bay 2: please park within the force fields.
All hands: the floor is once again the floor.
Replicator soup is sentient. Do not insult the soup.
Phasers set to stun. Coffee set to maximum.
Engineering requests fewer impossible deadlines.
Port nacelle offline. Starboard nacelle showing off.
Aft sensors report something. Very helpful, sensors.
Incoming hail. Not the frozen kind this time.
Turbolift 3 now stopping at actual decks.
Sickbay reminder: a tricorder is not a snack scanner.
Klingon karaoke tonight. Ear protection recommended.
Romulan ale found in coolant tank. Nice try.
Borg transmission blocked. Marked as spam.
Resistance is futile. Paperwork is mandatory.
Q has arrived. Cancel all reasonable expectations.
Deflector dish realigned. Television still unavailable.
Impulse engines ready. Impulse purchases discouraged.
Temporal anomaly ahead. Yesterday's lunch is tomorrow.
All hands: please stop feeding the anomaly.
Cargo Bay 4 contains Cargo Bay 4. Science is concerned.
Shields holding. Crew holding coffee.
Navigation reminder: space has no preferred lane.
First contact delayed. Universal translator updating.
Translator now supports sarcasm. Allegedly.
Life support stable. Morale requires biscuits.
Holodeck beach closed due to actual sharks.
Shuttlecraft keys found. Yes, we know they have none.
Captain on the bridge. Hide the fantasy fleet league.
Tricorder missing. Last seen scanning another tricorder.
Jefferies tube 8 is not a shortcut to the mess hall.
Plasma leak sealed. Engineering smells lightly toasted.
Warp speed approved. Running in corridors is not.
Replicator requests must include a food, not a feeling.
Computer has declined your request for more weekends.
Deck 5 reports an eerie glow. Probably decorative.
Cloaking device test complete. Please locate the ship.
Diplomatic dinner at 1900. Leave the bat'leths outside.
An away team is not a substitute for a delivery service.
Shuttle Bay 1: cloaked vessels must still sign in.
Containment field stable. Contents less cooperative.
Transporter buffer full. Delete duplicate admirals.
Please do not use photon torpedoes to open parcels.
Long-range sensors detect another mandatory meeting.
Crew quarters inspection postponed by mutual fear.
Science reports a breakthrough. Engineering wants tape.
All hands: the mysterious button was the doorbell.
Redshirts: today's away mission is a picnic. Probably.
Astrometrics requests someone name the new space blob.
The nebula is not judging you. Sensors confirm.
Warp core breach drill. Screaming is optional.
Replicator menu updated. Everything still tastes beige.
Shields raised. Expectations lowered.
Medical alert: coffee is not a complete food group.
Ten Forward is now accepting apologies as currency.
Emergency power routed to the waffle station.
Please return borrowed antimatter before end of shift.
Holodeck safety protocols on. Tempting fate discouraged.
Deck 9 fog cleared. Someone selected dramatic entrance.
Subspace interference traced to a very loud podcast.
Engineering has fixed the noise by adding a louder one.
Admiral arriving at 1600. Polish the plausible excuses.
Navigation has ruled out the scenic route through a sun.
Security reports no intruders. The cat is authorized.
Cargo manifest amended: 400 tribbles, not 4.
Replicator 6 is making gagh. Nobody ordered gagh.
Vulcan meditation class moved away from Klingon karaoke.
Time loop resolved. Time loop resolved.
Transporter test passed. Both volunteers agree.
Crew morale up 12%. Biscuit reserves down 90%.
The captain's chair does not have a massage setting.
Do not challenge the chess computer to single combat.
Docking complete. You may now unclench.
Aft shields flickering. Please stop calling it ambience.
Holodeck snow day cancelled. Snow has escaped.
Please label all samples before they label themselves.
A small moon is following us. Do not encourage it.
Crew reminder: the Prime Directive also applies on leave.
Shuttle 4 returned with extra moss. Science called dibs.
Deck 6 lights dimmed for tactical reasons. Not romance.
Sensor calibration complete. Space remains quite large.
Gravity at 98%. Enjoy your modest athletic improvement.
Turbolift music disabled after unanimous complaint.
Engineering requests a day without the word imminent.
Captain's tea located. Stand down from amber alert.
All systems nominal. Nobody say anything.
